surface_mechanism_description: Energetic radicals promote film deposition to improve growth continuity and inhibit impurities from residual precursors and by-products. The plasma energy during film formation contributes precursor absorption to the surface and suppresses nucleation delay.
evidence: Energetic radicals promote film deposition to improve growth continuity and inhibit impurities from residual precursors and by-products. Previous studies have reported the benefits of PEALD films including improved growth rate, reduced process temperatures, less oxygen and carbon contamination, and enhanced step coverages.
